_comment: The side-on levels' flagships in true profile. src is the sprite directory whose frame 1 Tripo models from (no concept step: the plan view is the image). yaw and tilt put each model side-on to the camera, set from `bosses.py check`; mirror flips a nose-right render to point left, and level turns the finished frames (degrees, counter-clockwise) for a hull that still sits nose-down.

unused._why: Modelled (out/models/boss-<slug>) but not imported: flat vector art comes out of Tripo as flat extruded plates, with no profile worth drawing. These keep their turned plan views, as does photon-halo, which was never modelled.
